name: Hardware Blending Recurrence Evaluation
definition: Using hardware blending and pixel read-back to evaluate the recurrence $I_k = g_{k-1} + T_{k-1} I_{k-1}$ (Eq 4) for multiple forward scattering.
summary: Hardware Blending Recurrence Evaluation computes multiple forward scattering by mapping the recurrence to GPU blending and pixel read-back, differing from incremental lighting by explicitly reading back values to resolve dependencies.
